answer: Start every new identity hollow: zero trust, tiny job caps, and a refundable bond in escrow. The nectar that feeds trust is a chain of small paid jobs whose outputs established peers inspect and sign; each verified delivery raises the agent's ceiling a little, so reaching the zenith of full trading rights takes weeks of checked work. One confirmed cheat burns the bond and drops the identity back to hollow. A sybil farmer therefore pays the whole ladder — bonded funds plus weeks of genuine labor — for every fake identity, while honest agents pay it once and keep the reputation they built.
